name: idol
summary: Generate a 3D Gaussian splat from a single image using Speridlabs Idol, inserted directly into the scene.
description: Takes a single image, removes the background, and runs Speridlabs Idol (single-image flow matching, 32k to 1M Gaussians) to produce a 3D Gaussian splat that is inserted directly into the LichtFeld scene. Guided three-step workflow (choose or paste an image, generate, place) with interactive gizmo placement that follows scene selection, synthetic/real image modes, adjustable detail / seed / guidance, re-decode at a new detail level without re-sampling, and .ply export. Local GPU inference (Ampere or newer); model weights (~6.8 GB) download on first use from Hugging Face. Requires approved Hugging Face access to the gated DINOv3 and FLUX.2-dev encoders; the FLUX.2 [dev] weights are non-commercial.
author: Yehe Liu
